## Checklist

- [ ] Every commit is signed off (`git commit -s`), for the [DCO](https://developercertificate.org/).
- [ ] The tests pass locally: `python -m unittest discover -s tests`.
- [ ] `ruff check .` passes (never `ruff format`).
- [ ] A tool whose behaviour, outputs or defaults change has its `version` bumped.
- [ ] `CHANGELOG.md` has a line for it.
- [ ] No preset values in the source, tests or docs (see `CONTRIBUTING.md`).
